name: Diagonal wipe
description: A raking diagonal edge with a glowing leading line. The boundary is combed into strips that lead and lag, so it arrives as a rake of teeth rather than one straight cut, and the outgoing frame is shoved along the same axis as it goes.

angle.description: Wipe direction, 0..1 mapped over half a turn.

chevron.description: Folds the edge into a V. 0 leaves it a straight diagonal.

teeth.description: Strips the edge is combed into across its width.

stagger.description: How far a strip may lead or lag the others.
